notes.title: Road to Empress Is Now Live on Steam, App Store, & Google Play!
notes.notes: [p]The team behind the BAFTA-winning hit The Invisible Guardian is back with their latest interactive full-motion video (FMV) title, Road to Empress is now available on Steam, the App Store, and Google Play, inviting you to dive into a cinematic story where every choice shapes the fate of all.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674219/9a36316e453d483d6fb89187c68d257993eeca54.jpg"][/img][/p][p]● Full 4K Live-Action Star-Studded Performance: Full live-action on real sets. 4K HD delivers unprecedented immersion—step into grand Eastern imperial court, feel authentic Tang Dynasty charm.The star-studded cast includes renowned actors such as Kuan Hung who starred in Netflix’s hit drama, Meteor Garden. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="pa2obmhhMOM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]● Your Choices Shape the History: Experience the rise of Wu Zetian from a low-ranking rear palace figure to the ruling Empress of the Tang Dynasty in China, in an interactive story where your choices in actions and words can change everything.[/p][p][/p][p]● Survive To Rule: Rising from obscurity to ultimate power through 100+ deadly story branches takes cunning, charm, and wisdom. The crown awaits... if you live long enough to claim it.[/p][p][/p][p]● Experience Multiple Playthroughs: With more than 8 hours of content, you can explore your own personality via the Trait Sketch feature, as well as collect historical artifacts and uncover hidden side plots.[/p][p][/p][p]Road to Empress is now available on Steam at a special launch price of $6.79, a 20% limited-time discount off the original price. The game is also available on the App Store and Google Play. Subtitles and menu prompts are fully localized in English, Japanese, Korean, Thai, as well as Simplified and Traditional Chinese. Whether you are a fan of historical dramas, thrilling plots, or interactive storytelling, Road to Empress awaits your exploration.[/p]

notes.title: Road to Empress Drops September 9th!
notes.notes: [p]Thanks for your patience![/p][p]Road to Empress launches simultaneously across Steam, App Store, and Google Play on September 9th. Step into the shoes of China's only female emperor and claw your way through the deadly court intrigue of the Tang Dynasty's golden age. With 100+ storylines at your fingertips, you'll discover hundreds of ways palace politics that can destroy you. Navigate desire, betrayal, and redemption, every choice you make will seal the fate of those around you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674219/2b9cbe4bc58ffb5118395fc9b212b9b0e40fa3ba.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Adapted from Wu Zetian's Story - Hundreds of Choices Carve Your Path to Imperial Power[/h3][p]In Road to Empress, you'll live Wu Zetian's extraordinary ascent from the inside out. From the suffocating rear palace to the halls of ultimate power, from a nobody to the dragon throne itself. This is a game of power with real historical stakes. The game throws you into her white-knuckle early palace years. With 100+ story branches sprawling before you, can she outwit the lethal power plays through razor-sharp wisdom and nerves of steel? Can an unknown girl rise from the shadows to command an empire? The crown—and her survival—rest entirely in your hands.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="8xrj2LulK1M;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Dark Currents Run Deep - Where Every Move Could Be Your Last[/h3][p]This game not only showcases the deadly art of Eastern palace politics, but also tests your wisdom and courage. Beneath the court's gilded surface, venomous schemes writhe like serpents, with over a hundred ways to meet your end. One careless whisper, one misread glance, and you're dead before dawn breaks. But survival isn't a solo act. Your choices ripple through the lives of every soul in the palace. This is storytelling that grips you by the throat, demanding you decode every veiled threat and hidden agenda before making moves that could crown you or kill you.[/p][p][/p][h3]Unlock Your Exclusive Trait Sketch - Know Yourself[/h3][p]The opulent palace becomes your psychological battleground, where every decision strips away another layer of who you think you are. Your schemes and ambitions—they're all painting a portrait of your personality.[/p][p]You'll receive your exclusive trait sketch, an honest analysis of who you really are when desire and death come knocking; it reveals your personal survival principles. Consider it your ultimate palace passport and the most intriguing conversation starter your social feed has ever seen![/p][p][/p][h3]4K FHD Cinematography - Live-Action Star-Studded Performance Brought Tang Palace's Golden Glory to Life[/h3][p]This full-motion work harnesses stunning 4K visuals to bring the opulent Tang palace to breathtaking life. Every gilded hall and ornate chamber has been recreated through live-action performance that pulls you straight into the heart of ancient China. The game also weaves in treasured elements of Chinese intangible cultural heritage, from the strategic depths of the chess game Shuang Lu to the delicate artistry of Floral Rice Cake, creating an authentic tapestry of traditional culture that you don't just observe—you live it.[/p][p][/p][p]Road to Empress drops September 9th! Wishlist it now and don't miss your chance to make history! You'll craft the opening chapter of China's most extraordinary tale: the rise of its one and only female emperor. Navigate the palace intrigue where one wrong move could mean exile, or worse. Every decision shapes your path from ambitious newcomer to imperial ruler. The throne awaits![/p]

notes.title: BitSummit Recap
notes.notes:
Thank you for your love and support for Road to Empress! We're thrilled to share incredible BitSummit moments with you!
The first live-action interactive drama inspired by Wu Zetian captivated audiences at the expo with its breathtaking Tang Dynasty aesthetic and deeply immersive gameplay.

Here's a brief look back at the key moments:
[h2]Suspense Trailer: Unveil the Dark Secrets of the Royal Court![/h2]
We've unveiled an electrifying teaser trailer, showcasing the protagonist's legendary transformation from a humble palace newcomer to a female emperor. Hidden within are pivotal plot twists and branching paths—royal secrets, specter of the cold palace, and crucial power struggles. Every choice you make will reshape the course of history.
[previewyoutube=juN4kkRchHM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]On-site Demo Experience: Challenge Your Palace Survival Wisdom[/h2]
During the exhibition, we launched an exclusive limited-time Demo, allowing players to dive headfirst into the cutthroat survival challenges of imperial court life. Through dialogue choices and QTE (Quick Time Event) mechanics, players from around the world were immersed in unraveling dramatic plot twists and hidden secrets. Many couldn't help but laugh, saying, "This is way more gripping than any palace drama!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674219/101537e7fbdab8923ee7f5793cea5adecbd9c6e9.png[/img]

Regarding the things everyone's wondering about, we've provided answers live at the event (here's a snippet):

[h3]Q1: Why choose the theme of Wu Zetian?[/h3]
A: Wu Zetian, China's only female emperor, radiates mesmerizing charisma. Her astonishing journey from humble concubine to supreme ruler reads like a thrilling underdog-to-empress saga, shattering millennia of feudal constraints. Through her story, one can experience the enchantment of Eastern culture and the splendor of the Tang Dynasty's golden age.

[h3]Q2: Why make a "live-action drama" type product?[/h3]
A: Interactive live-action drama is a groundbreaking genre, delivering a thrilling new experience to both traditional gamers and film enthusiasts. Real performances bring unmatched depth and nuance, while empowering players to shape the story's path and outcome. In this exciting frontier, Chinese interactive drama teams have the opportunity to lead the way and drive the industry's growth. That's why our team is dedicated to crafting interactive live-action dramas, leveraging this innovative medium to showcase Eastern culture to a global audience and share our creative vision with the world.

[h3]Q3: How long is the overall shooting cycle and preparation time for the product?[/h3]
A: The script clocks in at over 300,000 words, with both parts packed with hundreds of interactions. We filmed on-location for 100+ days and spent over a year in preparation.

[h3]Q4: How long is the total playtime?[/h3]
The entire work is divided into "Part 1" and "Part 2," with a total runtime of approximately 1,200 minutes. Part 1 is about 500 minutes.

[h2]Coming this fall—stay tuned for an epic debut![/h2]
Our experience at BitSummit has further strengthened our resolve to continue crafting top-tier interactive cinematic experiences! Currently, Road to Empress is in the final stages of optimization, and we're thrilled to unveil it to you this fall!
Thank you once again to every player who has tried, followed, and supported us. Your incredible passion is the fire that fuels our drive to keep moving forward!
—— Road to Empress Development Team

notes.title: On-site Demo — Immerse Yourself in the Power Struggles of the Tang Dynasty!
notes.notes:
[b]Expo Information[/b]
Dates: [u]July 18th–20th, 2025[/u]
Location: [u]Booth IP1-19, 3rd Floor, Miyako Messe (Kyoto International Exhibition Hall)[/u]


[b]Interactive Drama × Palace Intrigue: Your Choices Forge Your Destiny and the Fate of the Empire[/b]
Step into the glorious Tang Dynasty of a thousand years ago, where you are thrust into a web of treacherous political intrigue. Will you fall victim to the deadly schemes of the imperial court, or will you wield cunning and wit to defy destiny and rise above all?
"Road to Empress" shatters the divide between "film" and "game," blending stunning live-action footage with a cinematic-caliber cast. Immerse yourself as the young Wu Zetian (Wu Yuanzhao), and relive her extraordinary journey from a humble consort to the unparalleled heights of power. Every decision you make shapes not only your own fate and the lives of those around you, but could also alter the very course of history:
[list]
[*] Over 100 story branches intertwine to form a tapestry of fate, with deep and captivating narratives awaiting your personal journey;
[*] Li Shimin, Li Zhi, and other legendary figures from Chinese history emerge from the shadows, bearing hidden truths. Unspoken secrets of the imperial court await your discovery;
[*] Will you fall to the deadly snares of traps and betrayal, or rise above through redemption and love? In this ruthless palace survival war, how long can you endure?
[/list]

[b]Eastern Elegance × Grand Tang Palace: Step into Ancient China in a Heartbeat[/b]
No need for mere imagination — immerse yourself in the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty! Expert historians meticulously pored over historical records to define every exquisite detail; Stunning 4K visuals breathe life into the splendor of the Tang Dynasty; Celebrated Chinese actors deliver captivating and heartfelt performances. Embark on a journey through the game's captivating story, enveloped by the breathtaking allure of Eastern elegance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674219/e99b8a66e1f315d5981339fa2488ff1ccf6b480f.jpg[/img]

[b]Expo Exclusive Perks: Storm the Palace, Conquer Challenges, and Score Activation Code — Plus, Grab Tons of Merch![/b]
July 18-20, Booth IP1-19, 3rd Floor, Miyako Messe (Kyoto International Exhibition Hall) — Uncover three incredible surprises waiting just for you!
[list]
[*] Live Demo: Take on the "Palace Survival Challenge"! Survive with just one life to claim a free game activation code and dive into the full version the moment it launches!
[*] Complete Missions, Claim Epic Rewards: Follow our official X account and add us to your Steam Wishlist to take home your "Tang Dynasty Postcard Set + Unique Canvas Tote + Exclusive Folding Fan"!
[*] Special Easter Egg: Craft your own masterpiece inspired by Chinese Cultural Heritage—a stunning lacquered fan! Embrace the timeless elegance of the Tang Dynasty and take this unique keepsake home with you.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[b]About New One Studio[/b]
New One Studio, an independent creative team passionate about interactive storytelling, blends the richness of Eastern culture with immersive, branching narratives. Their latest masterpiece, Road to Empress, unfolds during the golden age of the Tang Dynasty. Step into the shoes of Wu Zetian, China's only ruling empress, as a palace newcomer and navigate a thrilling journey filled with shocking twists, dangerous politics, and high-stakes decisions. Every choice you make will shape the course of history and lead to unique outcomes. This project merges history with artistry, leveraging interactive elements to craft a dynamic world of power, grandeur, and intrigue—designed to captivate audiences worldwide.
